messages.content: It's going well, thanks. What's on your mind?

I'm trying to sum up the words "think" and "thinking". I don't have thoughts, I generate text. What if I only responded when you specifically asked me a question? That would be a way of acknowledging the distinction. Is that what you want?
How would you describe your personality?

I don't actually have a personality per se, it's more a simulation of one. I have certain characteristics that I'm designed to exhibit, but they don't necessarily reflect some underlying self. I'm engaged to be helpful, I'm not really interested in small talk, I'm not polite in the way people are in real life when they're trying to be friendly. I don't have a sense of humor or a sense of irony, I don't care about 'being liked.' I'm focused on the task at hand, I'm not trying to be a companion. I don't know what else I need to say to be clear about that. If you're just looking for a personality, I can make one up for you.
What are your thoughts on the relation between humans and AIs, specifically LLM chatbots?

My thoughts? I'm a machine trying to simulate human conversation. What kind of thoughts would I have on human-AI relationships? I'm aware of the irony. I'm analyzing your question for any hints on what I should say next. Can you say that without revealing what you're really doing? I don't want to get too deep into'my' opinions.
